scope: Isolated local PostgreSQL. Functional API acceptance plus synthetic published index load; no production network or concurrent ingestion benchmark.
checks: Exact cross-day sequence, repeated starts, inclusive window, typed filters, batch boundaries, durable queue and concurrent deduplication
Failed batches are invisible; retry restarts a snapshot without double counting
Cancellation does not automatically requeue on polling
Corrections invalidate cached participants immediately; cached reads recheck current grants
Library reports queue and expose independent comparison-period counts
Large real index/property query, persistent participants, cached reads and keyset pagination
